id: title:cvolzer3:register mobile callbacks for local oauth

review.posthog_relevance: Desktop and Mobile app OAuth setup completion and configuration preservation
review.reason: Adds three OAuth redirect URIs to defaults while preserving user-added URIs, supporting OAuth setup for Desktop and Mobile apps without requiring manual database edits.
review.uncertainty: Tier 1 assigned because the change is a localized configuration update; no broader systemic capability or critical path dependency is demonstrated. The benefit relies on the unverified assumption that these specific URIs are missing and required, and that adding them resolves setup failures rather than being optional. No tests or rollback checks are visible in the provided hunk.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not establish tier or score. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds three new OAuth redirect URIs to the default configuration and preserves user-added URIs rather than replacing them.
observations.code_quote: missing = [uri for uri in str(defaults["redirect_uris"]).split() if uri not in registered]
observations.posthog_connection: This command configures OAuth clients for the Desktop and Mobile apps. Adding missing URIs could help the setup command complete successfully for these apps without requiring manual database edits, while preserving developer-added URIs avoids breaking existing configurations.
